meta.title: The DDPM paper's sampler
meta.about: The classic text-to-image graph with the sampler set to ddpm. The paper used 1000 steps; a checkpoint's schedule can be walked in far fewer, and each step then spans many of the paper's.
needs: An SD 1.5 checkpoint in models/checkpoints (we used v1-5-pruned-emaonly). Any SD 1.5 file works; pick yours in the loader.

notes.5: sampler_name ddpm adds fresh noise at every step except the last, so the seed and the step count both matter.

inputs.text: a weathered brass astrolabe on an oak table, warm window light, photograph
